name: B10-0236/2025 (PPE) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Cameroon to stop holding journalists in prison for doing their job. It names five reporters jailed for years, some after trials by military courts. It says they should get fair trials and be released while their cases continue. It also asks the European Union and its member states to press Cameroon's government on these cases, especially before the 2025 presidential election. The Parliament cannot change Cameroon's laws itself; it is stating its position and making a request.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only asks Cameroon to release the five journalists and give them fair trials.
- The five named journalists and Cameroon's government are affected.
- The European Union and member states are asked to raise these cases with Cameroon.
